thread:
incident-bot: PAGERS: GPU pool east-1a-gpu-1 reporting POOL_EXHAUSTION (queue > 5k, avg latency 3.2s, token throttle active). Autoscaler heartbeat ok but scale-up requests failing with quota error. PagerDuty -> oncall-maya.

maya: acked. pulling metrics now. seeing sustained enqueue rate from hosted API + a spike from a single tenant (tenant=acme-ml).

dave: looks like autoscaler attempted to add 8 instances at 03:07:12 UTC and got 429 / quota-limit from provider: 
```
API_ERROR: quota vcpu limit reached for region us-east-1. request rejected
```

eli: added: we have a reserved pool in eu-west with free capacity. can we failover some traffic?

maya: good idea. initiating policy route to fallback to eu-west-1 reduced-capacity pool for non-low-latency routes. will keep high-priority routes pinned. doing gradual 10% shift.

sophia: CS: several customers are reporting 503s. acme-ml mentioned batch jobs timing out. I'm collecting impacted customer list now.

maya: mitigation plan (live):
- short-term: enable burst-capacity on east-1a (if provider allows) and route 25% of burstable requests to eu-west.
- mid-term: apply per-tenant soft throttling for top noisy tenants (acme-ml) to keep queues bounded.
- fallback: serve smaller quantized model variant (gpt-small-q4) for best-effort traffic.

arthur: impact to SLAs? need to notify sales + support.

maya: yes. 503s for < 0.5% of overall requests but concentrated on batch jobs. emailing support now.

dave: attempting manual scale with CLI to confirm provider error:
```
rwictl provider scale --region us-east-1 --pool east-1a-gpu-1 --count 8
# response
Error: quota_exceeded: vcpu_quota 512 reached
```

eli: provider quota is the blocker. I can request emergency quota increase but ETA ~ 30-45m. Meanwhile we should re-route and throttle.

maya: applying tenant throttles for top 3 noisy tenants: acme-ml, beta-retail, bigviz. command: 
```
console -> policies -> create throttle tenant=acme-ml rate=50rps
```

incident-bot: ACTIONS_CREATED: throttle-policy acme-ml (id=throt-983), route-shift job (id=rs-447).

ds: (dave) I pushed route-shift 10% -> eu-west (rs-447). queue delta: down 12% in 2m. latency on pinned traffic unchanged.

maya: started fallback rollout for low-priority traffic to gpt-small-q4; current roll 15% of non-PLG traffic.

sophia: CS update: notified 6 affected customers; we gave workaround to run jobs in eu-west. Ticket created TKT-8234 for acme-ml.

eli: emergency quota request sent (case #4321). provider acknowledged; manual review required.

arthur: can we enable cached prefix reuse to reduce cost for repeated requests? that might help reduce token compute immediately.

maya: enabling prefix/KV cache for eligible routes now. should shave ~20% CPU on chat workloads.

incident-bot: ALERT: queue length down to 1.1k (was 5.2k). throttles + route shift + fallback helping.

dave: logs show a retry storm from client library v1.2.1 for acme-ml. they retried every 500ms. recommended we ask them to back off and we've applied server-side rate limiting.

sophia: CS: informed acme-ml to update client to v1.3.0 which has exponential backoff. they acknowledged.

maya: current status: core pool healthy for pinned traffic. still monitoring for provider quota ack. remaining actions: follow up on quota, postmortem, and permanent autoscaler change to prefer cross-region spillover sooner.

eli: proposing config change for autoscaler: allow cross-region jittering when pool queue > 1000 for > 2m, plus a failover path to a shared bursting pool (internal flag enable_spill=true). assigning to dave to implement ramp.

dave: will create PR with autoscaler policy patch and add canary rollout in staging. ETA EOD. PR -> rwi/autoscaler#548.

maya: handing off to oncall-next for monitoring and follow-ups. oncall-next: can you take postmortem and run through action items?

oncall-next: took it. I'll keep watch and start the postmortem draft. main items:
- root cause: provider vCPU quota + noisy tenant retry pattern + autoscaler not spilling quickly across regions.
- mitigations that worked: tenant throttles, cross-region route shift, KV cache, fallback model.
- immediate action items: (1) autoscaler policy change (dave) (2) runbook update for quota failure (maya) (3) alerting tune: add quota-exhaustion SLO alert and a specific pager for provider quota (eli) (4) create tenant noisy-detection rule in runtime (sophia/dave)

incident-bot: SCHEDULED: postmortem draft created -> /docs/incidents/2968501122-postmortem-draft.md (visibility: internal).

maya: final note: we should consider reserved buffer capacity in key regions for hosted API to avoid single-provider limits affecting overall customers. adding to roadmap discussion.

sophia: thanks team — CS will follow up with customers tomorrow with details and RCA timeline.

eli: provider granted partial quota increase + we still need to request permanent bump. keep ticket open.

oncall-next: I'm taking ownership of the postmortem; will ping for reviews. handoff complete. :white_check_mark: 

maya: thanks all. closing incident thread when metrics stable for 1h. :eyes:
